usage: launch.py [-h] --implementation-root IMPLEMENTATION_ROOT --output-root
                 OUTPUT_ROOT --attempt ATTEMPT

New independent HE38 oracle execution with hard 30 CPU second / 512 MiB
limits. Existing attempts are refused.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --implementation-root IMPLEMENTATION_ROOT
                        Restored unit/components/finite_mass directory
                        containing h1_finite_mass.
  --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
                        Parent for a new exclusive attempt directory and
                        launch receipts.
  --attempt ATTEMPT     Unique attempt name; never reuses attempt_001 or
                        overwrites existing evidence.

usage: run_oracle.py [-h] --implementation-root IMPLEMENTATION_ROOT
                     --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT --attempt ATTEMPT

Portable HE38 raw quadrature runner; invoke through portable/launch.py for
hard resource limits.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --implementation-root IMPLEMENTATION_ROOT
                        Directory containing the restored h1_finite_mass
                        package.
  --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
                        Fresh-run parent directory; existing attempt
                        directories are never overwritten.
  --attempt ATTEMPT     Unique single-component attempt name.

numerical_path_changes: implementation_root argument only; raw quadrature/comparison/refinement bodies identical
overwrite_policy: launcher atomic exclusive reservation; runner mkdir exist_ok=False; every receipt open x
